元素比例。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s28.outbound-vitality-drain","weight":0.05,"reason":"土封压限制敌人，不护住归炉的器命燃料；外飞每秒供薪仍照常扣除，镇压不会变成器命防御或修复。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s28.source-status-damage","weight":0,"reason":"镇压没有持续伤害，归炉的来源状态倍率不会提高其减速或创造土跳伤；也不把控制持续时间换算成伤害。"}]},"provenance":{"sourcePaths":["assets/packs/content/base-returning-sword/weapons/atlas-s28/effects/hit-stages/atlas-s28.earth-pressure-seal/effect.pack.ts","assets/packs/content/base-returning-sword/weapons/atlas-s28/weapon.pack.ts","src/combat/sword-combat.ts","src/combat/combat-runtime.ts"],"legacyNodeIds":["binding:atlas-s28:sword-stage:4"]},"designNotes":["土封压不会提高炉体器命或储存更多火力。","控制与本次火主伤害分开解释，不增加额外一次攻击。"],"placement":{"contentPackId":"base-returning-sword","categoryPath":["weapons","atlas-s28","effects","hit-stages"],"scope":"exclusive","owner":{"kind":"weapon","id":"atlas-s28","name":"五炁归炉"}}}}
